risks.title: Dependence on credit and capital markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned early in Item 1A, with strong language on market uncertainty. The company is highly reliant on access to credit and equity through ATM programs. The Capital category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Loss of investment grade credit rating
risks.score_rationale: A detailed table shows the immediate impact of rating downgrade on collateral requirements (up to $92M for ACE). The risk is quantified and concrete, with a cascading effect on liquidity.

risks.title: High long-term financial commitments
risks.score_rationale: The future payments table shows $116,978M in cash requirements. The total amount is high but spread over decades. The language is factual, without explicit alarm.

risks.title: Capital expenditure variability
risks.score_rationale: Capital expenditures are significant and subject to revision. The text explicitly mentions variability due to economic conditions, with major operational impact.

risks.title: Pension contribution risk
risks.score_rationale: The text directly links interest rates and asset performance to future contribution needs ($325M in 2026). Significant cash flow impact if assumptions are not met.

risks.title: Renewable energy purchase commitments
risks.score_rationale: Long-term commitments (through 2044) for $8,006M in RECs and renewable energy. Risk of overpayment if market prices decline. Mentioned in financial obligations, but without alarming language.

ai_positioning.summary: EXC does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
